 ABILASH, S/O. PAVITHRAN, AGED 34 YEARS, PUTHENVILAYIL HOUSE,

 THE STATE OF KERALA, REPRESENTED BY THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, HIGH  COURT OF KERALA, ERNAKULAM  This Criminal Miscellaneous Application coming on for orders on 12.07.2024,praying that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to grant permission to the applicant to renew his passport bearing No. B2901385,
upon perusing the application and upon hearing the arguments of SRI.S.SREEKUMAR(SR.) and NIDHEESH.S, Advocates for the petitioner in Crl MA 1/24 and PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent in Crl MA 1/24 , the court on the same day passed the following:
 P.G. AJITHKUMAR, J.

 Dated this the 12th day of July, 2024  ORDER

sentences.text: The petitioner was convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 376(1) and 417 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
He was sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a period of eight years.
This Court as per the order dated 08.10.2014 suspended execution of the sentence.
The appeal is yet to be heard and decided.
Since this appeal is pending, the petitioner cannot get his passport renewed.

However, considering the fact that this appeal is not able to be disposed of immediately, I am of the view that petitioner can be Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2014 in granted permission to get the passport renewed in accordance with law and following guidelines issued in that regard.

5. In the light of the law laid down by this Court in Akhilesh v. State of Kerala [2021(2) KLT 553]
and Asok Kumar v. State of Kerala [2009(2) KLT 712], the petitioner is entitled to get the passport renewed subject to the condition that he can travel abroad only with permission obtained specifically in that regard.

While issuing passport, the authorities concerned are obliged to obey the directions issued by this Court in Thadevoose Sebastian v. Regional Passport Officer,
